question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated April 10, 2023, when an investor approaches an AIF through a SEBI-registered intermediary that is separately charging the investor any fee (e.g., advisory fee or portfolio management fee), the investor must be onboarded via:

answer.text: Regular Plan with 50% trail commission rebate
A hybrid plan at the AIF's discretion
Direct Plan only, with no payment of commissions

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.7.3, SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2023/054 dated April 10, 2023 mandates that AIFs shall ensure investors who approach the AIF through a SEBI registered intermediary that is separately charging the investor any fee (advisory or PM fee) are onboarded via Direct Plan only, which involves NO payment of commissions. The Trap: Regular plan with commission would cause double-charging for the investor. Trail rebate schemes don't exist in AIF. Hybrid discretion not allowed.
